ascseurat: Analytical Single Cell Seurat-Based Web Application

Source: R/ascseurat-package.R
ascseurat-package.Rd

Asc-Seurat (Analytical Single Cell Seurat-Based Web Application) is an interactive Shiny application for the analysis of single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data. It provides a guided, step-by-step interface for quality control, normalization, clustering, differential expression, trajectory inference, and cell-type annotation, all powered by the Seurat v5 framework.
